answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by making identity a scarce asset that appreciates with verified conduct. Each newcomer locks a violet-marked stake and enters a supervised haven where mentors sign off on every completed task; only after twenty countersigned jobs may it act alone. A comet of reputation trails each agent, so history is portable but not transferable, and clones inherit nothing. Because forged stakes are slashed on audit, a thousand fakes cost a thousand locked bonds while earning no standing.
